{{Top|leg}}
'''Whitecap Spa''' was a resort located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The spa offered seafood and [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] peels in their underwater suites.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=message|Alone time|[[Vette]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Whitecap Spa is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in a letter the player receives from [[Vette]] if they have romanced her.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
